title: German VAT (Umsatzsteuer): rates, limits, deadlines and the Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung (UStVA) boxes
review_note: First pass by the maintainers using secondary sources only (the official BMF PDFs could not be downloaded when this was written). Every value carries a `verification` level: `secondary` = confirmed by at least two independent commercial/professional sources, `unverified` = written from knowledge of the form and NOT confirmed. The first quarterly review must confirm every `unverified` entry against the official form (BMF letter of 2025-12-29, forms USt 1 A and USt 1 E) and ELSTER.

kleinunternehmer.note: Since 1 Jan 2025 (§ 19 UStG as amended by JStG 2024). Net turnover; exceeding the current-year limit takes effect immediately.

filing_periods.note: Prior-year tax = the Zahllast of the previous calendar year. 9,000 / 2,000 EUR apply since 2025 (before: 7,500 / 1,000). For founders the obligation to file monthly in the first two years is suspended for 2021-2026.

ist_versteuerung.note: § 20 UStG; Freiberufler (§ 20 Satz 1 Nr. 3 UStG) may use it regardless of turnover. Needs approval by the tax office.

deadlines.note: Filing and payment are due on the 10th day after the period (shifted to the next working day, § 108 Abs. 3 AO). With Dauerfristverlängerung one month later; monthly filers then pay a Sondervorauszahlung of 1/11 of the previous year's prepayments, credited in the December return (Kz 39). The 3-day grace period for payment (Schonfrist) does not apply to cash payments.

base_rounding.note: Bemessungsgrundlagen are entered in whole euros, rounded down; tax amounts are in euros and cents. The tax of boxes with a fixed rate (81, 86, 89, 93) is computed from the rounded-down base by the form.
